opportunities.observation: Pinned Gemma4DecoderLayer.forward calls post_attention_layernorm and immediately passes its BF16 output into pre_feedforward_layernorm(hidden_states, residual); the exact trace has 3660 fused-add RMSNorm calls and 7381 same-shape RMSNorm-family calls.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Measured exact H200 c32 capture plus pinned source; selected call-site time uses source-count apportionment within the same [M,5376] RMSNorm family.
competing_explanations: The boundary is launch/materialization limited and a one-CTA-per-row fused lifecycle can retain the first normalized vector.
Both full-width reductions and BF16 rounding dominate, so eliminating one launch and one intermediate write/read is negligible.
The intermediate remains L2-resident, making the compulsory-HBM byte estimate an overstatement.
opportunities.mechanism: Fuse the two rowwise reductions and residual add into one lifecycle while preserving the BF16 round after the first RMSNorm and the BF16 residual update.
opportunities.falsifier: Credit the complete two-kernel block as zero-cost; kill target-H200 admission if even that impossible bound is below 1% of the fixed qualified request.
opportunities.next_measurement: None for this selected seam: the localized source/trace falsifier is decisive. Redirect to a boundary with measured non-GEMM removable wall share above 1%.
opportunities.intuition: Two adjacent row reductions look attractive to a task graph, but their full-block wall share is small enough that a zero-cost bound can decide before implementation.
opportunities.promotion_rule: Promote only if a corrected attribution raises the impossible zero-cost upper bound to at least 1% of the fixed request and preserves both BF16 rounding points.
opportunities.kill_rule: Kill the selected seam when the zero-cost upper bound is below 1% or the exact rounding contract cannot be preserved.
opportunities.residual_bottleneck_rule: FP8 GEMMs, attention, and synchronization remain outside this seam and dominate after any hypothetical fusion.

Prior fused RMSNorm-to-FP8 and SwiGLU-to-FP8 paths show dominant shapes can regress even when launches disappear.
opportunities.mechanism: Move per-row amax/scale and E4M3 conversion into a consumer-compatible FP8 GEMM prologue without changing per-token scale semantics.
opportunities.falsifier: Exact-shape H200 component pair with real weights and unchanged fp8_scaled_mm output oracle; require positive warm interval after full output consumption.
opportunities.next_measurement: Only after a consumer implementation exists: one M=32,K=5376 QKV or gate/up prologue discriminator with row-scale identity and compiled resource evidence.
opportunities.intuition: The larger measured standalone producer family is real, but a scale reduction before GEMM limits a simple task-graph fusion.
opportunities.promotion_rule: Promote a specific projection only after correct real-consumer timing is positive and compiled resources do not erase the saved producer.
opportunities.kill_rule: Kill any prologue that changes per-token scale identity, requires a global synchronization equivalent to the stock launch, or regresses M=32.
opportunities.residual_bottleneck_rule: Weight-streaming FP8 GEMMs and attention remain dominant.
